allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Conan is commissioned by the evil queen Taramis to safely escort a teen princess and her powerful bodyguard to a far away castle to retrieve the magic Horn of Dagoth. Unknown to Conan, the queen plans to sacrifice the princess when she returns and inherit her kingdom after the bodyguard kills Conan. The queen's plans fail to take into consideration Conan's strength and cunning and the abilities of his sidekicks: the eccentric wizard Akiro, the warrior woman Zula, and the inept Malak. Together the hero and his allies must defeat both mortal and supernatural foes in this voyage to sword-and-sorcery land.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Conan's mission seems straightforward, but Queen Taramis has secretly marked both him and the princess for betrayal once the magical horn is found.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Hired by Queen Taramis to guide a young princess and her bodyguard on a perilous quest for the magical Horn of Dagoth, Conan embarks across sword-and-sorcery lands unaware of a deadly scheme awaiting their return.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast, exciting sword-and-sorcery adventure with spirited comic relief, built for an easygoing watch with friends.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Richard Fleischer balances classic fantasy combat with dynamic swordplay, pitting a colorful band of eccentric allies against supernatural perils at an exhilarating, fast pace.
